messages:
maria_zhou: Proposal: define a narrow golden path for span/event attributes to keep telemetry cardinality bounded and cost attribution accurate. Required set: service, env, route, hashed_customer_id, request_type. Max 3 freeform customer keys per span.

sam_kapoor: sounds reasonable. enforcement?

maria_zhou: three-layer enforcement: SDK lint (dev warnings), CI checks (block new violations), ingest guardrails (trim + label excess keys and emit governance metrics).

james: partners needing lots of attributes?

maria_zhou: partner opt-in via allowlist and per-tenant attribute quotas; add explicit billing_tag to preserve attribution.

linh_tran: sampling will skew billing if not careful.

maria_zhou: make sampling tenant-aware. billing tenants get deterministic or 100% sampling; general telemetry uses statistical sampling. Always emit sampling_probability for reweighting.

sam_kapoor: metric/log/span joins need a stable request id.

maria_zhou: canonicalize request_id header (X-RD-REQ) else fallback to trace_id; include short_trace (8 chars) in metrics.

james: SDK vs proxy behavior differences?

maria_zhou: SDKs do local lint and PII hashing; canonicalization/trimming happens at proxy/ingest to ensure consistency.

linh_tran: alerts when trimming spikes?

maria_zhou: ingest will emit trimmed_spans_count, trimmed_keys_by_team, top_trimmed_keys. Alert if trimmed_spans spike or any tenant >1% trimmed. Weekly migration impact reports per product.

devops-bot: feature flag ingest.attr_guardrails.v1 created (default=false). Owners: @maria_zhou, @sam_kapoor.

james: next: draft RFC with enforcement matrix and migration timeline. I'll help with the governance dashboard mockups.

maria_zhou: I'll draft RFC today. Tradeoff: narrower instrumentation now for predictable costs and reliable billing later. :thumbsup:
